overview.title: Overview
overview.noClicksYet: No clicks yet. Share your links and come back.
overview.emptySub: Create your first short link and watch the zeros roll in.

table.title: Links
table.emptySub: Try another search, tag or status.
table.emptyAllSub: Paste a long URL anywhere on this screen or create the first one. Every click is counted with country, device and referrer.

new.title: New link
new.sub: One, many, or everything you had on Bitly.
new.slugReserved: Reserved word. Use it on a custom domain.
new.formDesc: Paste the long URL. The slug is optional: leave it empty and one is generated.
new.formNote: You can change everything later in the link settings.
new.slugHelp: Leave empty to generate one. 2 to 32 characters: letters, numbers, - and _.
new.advancedHint: Title, tags, UTM, redirect, expiry, password
new.ogHelp: How the link looks on WhatsApp, X or Slack. Empty uses the destination page preview.
new.forwardParamsLabel: Pass query parameters to the destination
new.forwardParamsHelp: Opening the short link with ?utm_source=newsletter adds it to the destination. If the destination already has that parameter, the one on the short link wins.
new.expiredUrlHelp: Where visitors go once the link expires or reaches its click limit. Leave it empty to show the default page.
new.utmSyncHelp: Changing a field updates the destination URL, and editing the URL updates these fields.

detail.archiveDesc: Stops redirecting. Analytics are kept and you can unarchive it any time.
detail.deleteDesc: Deletes the link and all its analytics. This cannot be undone.
detail.noClicksCountry: No clicks from that country in this range.
detail.routeBranches: {n, plural, one {+# routed destination} other {+# routed destinations}}
detail.slugHelp: Changing it breaks the old short link.
detail.advancedHint: UTM, redirect, expiry, limit, password, preview
detail.unarchiveDesc: Starts redirecting to the destination again.
detail.emptyBody: Share <data>{short}</data> and clicks show up here.

bulk.title: Many links at once
bulk.sub: Up to 200 URLs, one per line. Slugs are generated for you.
bulk.count: {n, plural, =0 {No URLs yet} one {# URL} other {# URLs}}

settings.title: Settings
settings.demoDesc: Demo mode is on: everyone is the same demo user. In production you sign in with Google.
settings.name: Name
settings.apiKeysDesc: Use a key with the public API: Authorization: Bearer zs_…
settings.keyWarning: Copy it now. You won't see it again. Ever.

aiUsage.title: AI usage
aiUsage.sub: Tokens used by AI features (chat bot) in this workspace this month.
aiUsage.notConfigured: AI is not configured on this server. Set AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY (or deploy on Vercel with AI Gateway) to enable AI features.
aiUsage.quotaNote: When the free quota runs out, AI features pause until next month and fall back to non-AI behavior.

settings.scopesHint: What this key can do. Keys created before scopes have all of them.

gone.notfoundSub: It never existed, was deleted or archived. Like all dead software.
gone.expiredSub: It reached its expiration date and no longer redirects.
gone.limitSub: This link already served all the clicks it was allowed.
gone.passwordSub: You need the password to pass through.

errors.empty: At least one URL is required.
errors.too_many: Too many URLs. Max 200 per batch.
errors.bad_request: Some field isn't valid. Check the lengths and formats.
errors.invalid_targeting_url: One of the targeting destinations is not a valid URL.
errors.empty_rule: Each rule needs at least one country or device.
errors.ab_needs_two: An A/B test needs at least two variants.
errors.ab_zero_weight: At least one A/B variant needs a weight above zero.
errors.rate_limited: Too many requests. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.self_link: A short link can't point to another short link of ours.
errors.quota_exceeded: You reached today's limit of new links. Try again tomorrow.
errors.forbidden: Only workspace admins can do this.
errors.invalid_expired_url: The redirect after expiry doesn't look like a valid URL.

webhooks.desc: We POST a signed JSON payload to your URL when these events happen. Verify the Zerosoft-Signature header (t=…,v1=HMAC-SHA256 of "t.body") with your secret. Failed deliveries are retried with backoff.
webhooks.secretWarning: You won't see this secret again.

errors.private_host: That host points to a private network.
errors.invalid_input: Enter a URL and pick at least one event.
errors.generic: Couldn't add the webhook. Try again.

domains.title: Domains
domains.desc: Add it, create the DNS record, then verify. HTTPS is set up automatically.
domains.dnsHelp: Create these records at your DNS provider: the TXT proves the domain is yours. Changes can take a few minutes.
domains.name: Name
domains.verifiedNow: Verified. You can now pick this domain when creating links.
domains.notYet: DNS isn't pointing here yet. Try again in a few minutes.

errors.invalid_hostname: That isn't a valid domain (e.g. go.example.com).
errors.domain_taken: That domain is already in use.
errors.provider_error: Couldn't register the domain with the hosting provider. Try again.
errors.has_links: This domain still has links. Move or delete them first.
errors.too_many_pending: You have 5 domains waiting for verification. Verify or remove one first.
errors.rate_limited: Too many domains added. Wait a while and try again.

domains.txtMissing: We can't see the TXT record yet. Check its name and value; DNS can take a few minutes.
domains.emptyBody: Until then, your links use the zerosoft domain.
domains.notFoundPlaceholder: Where an unknown go.yourcompany.com/slug should go (optional)
domains.expiredPlaceholder: Default for expired links without their own redirect (optional)
domains.redirectsHelp: Leave a field empty to use the default page.

export.title: Your data
export.desc: Download every link. CSV has one row per link; JSON also includes every click (referrer, country, device). No hostages.

import.title: Import from Bitly
import.desc: Bring your links with their back-halves. If you verified the same custom domain here first, they keep working as-is once you move the DNS.
import.tokenHelp: In Bitly, go to Settings > API > Generate token. We use it once and don't store it.
import.csvHelp: In Bitly, Links > Export (or any CSV with a long URL column).
import.truncated: Only the first 2,000 were imported; run it again for the rest.
import.renamed: {n} got a new back-half (it was taken)

errors.bitly_no_group: That Bitly account has no group.
errors.csv_no_url_column: We couldn't find a long URL column in that CSV.
errors.rate_limited: Too many imports. Wait a few minutes.

bio.title: Bio page
bio.sub: One page with your links at zerosoft.ai/@{handle}. Each button goes through the short link, so clicks show up in your analytics.
bio.linksHint: Check the links to show and order them. Password-protected, archived and expired links are hidden.
bio.error: Check the fields (avatar must be an https URL).
bio.searchPlaceholder: Search other links by title, slug or URL
bio.chosen: {n, plural, =0 {No links chosen} one {# link on the page} other {# links on the page}}
bio.emptyBody: Create a link and come back to add it.
bio.notShown: Not shown on the public page.

bulkActions.label: Actions on selected links
bulkActions.tagPartial: Tagged {affected} of {total}. The rest already had that tag or 5 tags.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.sub: All your links together. Dates in UTC.
analytics.emptyBody: Share a link and clicks show up here.

targeting.title: Routing
targeting.hint: Send each visitor to a different destination by country, device or A/B variant. With no rules, the link goes to its URL.
targeting.rulesHint: The first matching rule wins. With no countries or devices, it applies to everyone.
targeting.abHint: Splits visits by weight. Each visitor always sees the same variant.
targeting.deepHint: Tries to open your app. If it is not installed, goes to the fallback (store or web).
targeting.countriesInvalid: Use two-letter country codes (AR, US, BR).
targeting.incompleteRow: Every rule and A/B variant needs a destination URL. Fill it in or remove the row.
targeting.clearConfirm: Remove all rules, A/B variants and deep links from this link?
targeting.ipadNote: iPads with Safari identify as a Mac, so they get the desktop destination.

qr.logoHint: PNG, JPG or WebP up to 200 KB. With a logo, the QR uses high error correction.
qr.logoTooBig: The logo is larger than 200 KB.
qr.lowContrast: Low contrast: some scanners will not read it.
qr.scansNote: The QR points to {url}: scans are counted apart from clicks.
qr.loadError: Couldn't load the QR. Reload the page.
qr.designDesc: Colors, modules and logo. Saved for every download.

states.errorBody: Try again. If it keeps failing, tell us from Feedback.
